explanations: change() deletes the cached menu before the database write has committed. Any getMenu() that runs in that window misses the cache, reads the old row from the store, and puts it back into the cache, where it stays for the full ten-minute TTL after the write lands. That's why edits only stick when nobody is browsing. The fix invalidates after the write: readers during the write still get the old cached menu (correct, since the change isn't committed yet), and the first read after the delete loads the new data.
